verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own notification system fires actions on error events. Webhooks "can be sent for the same triggers as our other notifications channels" to any external service, and the PagerDuty integration automatically creates, updates and resolves incidents. That shows event-triggered actions exist, but the pack never describes how users define the rules themselves, such as conditions, filters or thresholds. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined rule conditions and filters, actions beyond notifying or pushing data (e.g. auto-assign or status changes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
